summary.text: Mark Dean is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 34, listed with Mingo County. His legislative page lists him as vice chair of the Government Administration Committee.

paragraphs.text: Dean's page gives his birth date as June 18, 1980, and his birthplace as Logan, West Virginia.
It lists a bachelor's in education from Concord College (2003) and a master's in school leadership from Marshall University (2005), and gives his occupation as home health executive.
His affiliations include Phi Sigma Phi National Fraternity, the Knight of the Golden Horseshoe and the Mingo County Republican Executive Committee.
Dean also serves on the House's Government Organization, Health and Human Resources and Public Health committees.
